cases.name: Sherry Gordon
cases.about: Her reading teacher said she tried hard and was the only pupil allowed to claim a prize from a box in her room because she had earned a perfect score on a paper. She described her as well-liked on the playground and shy.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; SUSPECT DECEASED WHEN ID'D
cases.narrative: On 11/2/1984, her body and that of her cousin Theresa Hall, 9 was found in an empty apartment that was being remodeled in the former Longview Place public housing complex
